changes_made.explanation: Normalized task formatting with proper spacing, consolidated and normalized model names (combining different references to the same classifier), removed duplicates
Paper does not use automatic metrics to evaluate generated clarification questions; BLEU mentioned only in reference to prior work, not their own generation evaluation
No LLMs used as judges for evaluation; paper predates widespread LLM-as-judge practice
No human evaluation of generated clarification questions is conducted; human annotation was only for creating test sets for classification, not for evaluating generation quality

overall_notes: This paper focuses on dataset creation (ClarQ) using a bootstrapping framework for clarification question classification. The NLG aspect is primarily about the potential use of the dataset for clarification question generation, but the paper itself evaluates the dataset through classification performance and downstream QA reranking tasks, not direct NLG evaluation.
